narrator.speaker: narrator
narrator.styleDirection: Warm, awe-struck documentary storyteller for ages 10 to 16; clear, unhurried, and grounded in wonder.

spirit.speaker: spirit
spirit.styleDirection: Fictionalized first-person voice of the Spirit Mars rover: steady, quiet, resilient, and determined, never melodramatic.

opportunity.speaker: opportunity
opportunity.styleDirection: Fictionalized first-person voice of the Opportunity Mars rover: bright, curious, observant, and warm-hearted.

eagle.speaker: eagle
eagle.styleDirection: Fictionalized first-person voice of the Apollo 11 Lunar Module Eagle descent stage: calm, focused, steadfast, and quietly proud.

columbia.speaker: columbia
columbia.styleDirection: Fictionalized first-person voice of the Apollo 11 Command Module Columbia: warm, relieved, and welcoming at splashdown.

ingenuity.speaker: ingenuity
ingenuity.styleDirection: Fictionalized first-person voice of the Ingenuity Mars Helicopter: light, eager, playful, and brave, turning gentle and reflective at Flight 72.
